scope: Current delivery status and first-slice contract. Earlier approved specification text is preserved.

manual_review.rules: Direct instructions and descriptive sentences reviewed. Paragraphs divided by topic.
manual_review.dictionary: CREATE replaced with make in new prose. CHECK used as a noun. Existing project dictionary decisions retained.
manual_review.technical_terms: API, worktree, frontend, backend, SQLite, Cognito, DynamoDB, SAM, commit, PKCE, and pipeline retain their software meanings. See the project language guide.
manual_review.protected_content: API fields, commands, feature IDs, 115 existing acceptance rows, approval history, numerical limits, and source identifiers preserved. New test counts are explicit results.
manual_review.limitations: Selected vocabulary and technical meaning reviewed. Mechanical results do not establish full ASD-STE100 compliance or ASD approval.
